---
title: "R code to generate Baseline adjusted barplot"
output: html_document
params:
    ordinal_data: NA
    no_doseI: NA
    toxicI: NA
    times_I: NA
    ordinal_date: NA
    showExtra: NA
    invert: NA
    title: NA
    titlesize: NA
    subtitle: "Symptomatic Adverse Event"
---

```{r}
print(params[-1])

## To install the required packages, uncomment the following lines and run them once
# install.packages("ggplot2", "DT", "magrittr", "dplyr", "ggsurvfit", "ggh4x", "tidyr", "gt", "gridExtra", "survminer")
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggh4x)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(gridExtra)
library(survminer)

# Define parameters
ordinal_data <- params$ordinal_data
no_doseI <- params$no_doseI
toxicI <- params$toxicI
times_I <- params$times_I
ordinal_date <- params$ordinal_date

# Create list of timepoints within the range
end_list <- unique(ordinal_data %>% filter(timepoint <= times_I) %>% select(timepoint))

# Create variables for the earliest and latest timepoints within the range
end <- max(end_list$timepoint)
tp_end <- as.symbol(paste0("tp_", end))

start <- min(unique(ordinal_data$timepoint))
tp_start <- as.symbol(paste0("tp_", start))

# Filter data to relevant PRO domains and doses, then calculate the change between the earliest and latest timepoints and long baseline adjusted score
ordinal_data <- ordinal_data %>%
  filter(toxicity %in% toxicI) %>%
  filter(dose %in% no_doseI) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(has_tp = any(timepoint == end)) %>%
  filter(timepoint <= end) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = grade, names_prefix = "tp_") %>% # The app uses an older version of tidyr. Newer versions may require an additional argument id_cols = c(id, has_tp) to avoid an error
  mutate(grade_change = !!tp_end - !!tp_start) %>%
  mutate(base_adj = case_when(
    has_tp == FALSE ~ "ICE",
    TRUE ~ ifelse(grade_change > 0, as.character(!!tp_end), as.character(1))
  ))

# Replace missing values with "Unreproted" and filter out "Unreported" if showExtra is FALSE
ordinal_data$base_adj[is.na(ordinal_data$base_adj) == TRUE] <- "Unreported"

if (params$showExtra == FALSE) {
  ordinal_data <- ordinal_data %>% filter(base_adj != "Unreported")
}

# Calculate the proportion of patients in each baseline adjusted category for each toxicity and dose
prop <- ordinal_data %>%
  group_by(toxicity, dose) %>%
  count(base_adj) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(original = TRUE) %>%
  complete(toxicity, dose, base_adj, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(toxicity, dose) %>%
  mutate(n.pat = sum(n[base_adj != "ICE"], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / n.pat) %>%
  dplyr::select(-n)

# Convert variables to factors and set levels for plotting
prop$toxicity <- as.factor(prop$toxicity)
prop$base_adj <- as.factor(prop$base_adj)
prop$dose <- as.factor(prop$dose)
levels(prop$base_adj) <- c(levels(prop$base_adj), "Unreported")
prop$dose <- factor(prop$dose, levels = rev(levels(prop$dose)))
prop <- prop %>% subset(base_adj != "ICE")

# Logic to invert the order of bars if invert is TRUE
if (params$invert == TRUE) {
  prop$base_adj <- factor(prop$base_adj, levels = rev(c("Unreported", 5, 4, 3, 2, 1)))
} else {
  prop$base_adj <- factor(prop$base_adj, levels = c("Unreported", 5, 4, 3, 2, 1))
}

# Create a data frame with the doses and number of patients to assist in plot labeling
ice_n_patI <- prop %>% distinct(dose, n.pat)

# Formatter function to create facet labels
formatterI <- function(SAE = toxicI, subtitle = params$subtitle) {
  paste(subtitle, SAE, sep = " ")
}
if (params$showExtra == FALSE) {
  groupsizes <- c()
  for (i in toxicI) {
    pat_numbs <- prop %>%
      filter(toxicity == !!i) %>%
      distinct(dose, n.pat) %>%
      select(n.pat)
    groupsizes <- append(groupsizes, paste(unlist(pat_numbs), collapse = "; "))
  }
  formatterI <- function(SAE = toxicI) {
    paste(params$subtitle, SAE, paste0("(N=", groupsizes, ")"), sep = " ")
  }
} else {
  formatterI <- function(SAE = toxicI) {
    paste(params$subtitle, SAE, sep = " ")
  }
}

# Generate the baseline adjusted barplot
prop %>% ggplot(aes(fill = base_adj, x = dose, y = proportion * 100)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(toxicity ~ ., scales = "free_y", labeller = as_labeller(formatterI)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = rev(c(1:5, "Unreported")),
    values = rev(c("darkgreen", "lightgreen", "yellow", "orange", "red", "darkgrey")),
    labels = rev(c("None", "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe", "Very Severe", "Unreported")),
    guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = if (params$showExtra == FALSE) {
      paste0("Dose")
    } else {
      paste0("Dose (N=", paste(ice_n_patI$n.pat, collapse = "; "), ")")
    },
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    fill = "Severity Score"
  ) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
  ggtitle(params$title) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = params$titlesize, face = "bold"))
```
